angleRead.name: Jordan Velez
angleRead.text: I'm heading to West Oakland to dig into the business pulse there. Oakmesh Systems and Civis Systems are on my radar—both showing growth, but I want to see what that looks like on the ground. I’ll start with Elijah Roberts at Oakmesh, a construction laborer, and see how the expansion is affecting the workers. Then, I’ll swing by Civis Systems to talk with Sam Fazio, a digital twin architect, and get a sense of how their urban systems intelligence work is shaping up. The numbers tell one story, but I want to hear it from the people clocking in every day.
